newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico's Bufete upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico's Bufete upgraded.

text.p: Valores Finamex brokerage upgraded Monday Mexico's Bufete Industrial to a buy recommendation from a hold.

"Bufete Industrial is the fastest-growing construction company in Mexico; although the lack of projects the last two years has hurt, the company is now ready to capitalize on higher spending by government utilities," Finamex analyst Luis Antonio de Leon said.

"For 1997, we calculate a target price of 85.7 pesos per CPO ($29.5 per ADR), which represents an attractive 48.7 percent annualized return in dollar terms. Based on this objective, we are upgrading Bufete from hold to buy," he said.

"Investors overreacted to Bufete's failure to win the Merida III thermoelectric plant. They bid the stock down 12 percent since January 21. We believe current prices represent a compelling entry level," Finamex added.
